focus: Driving penalties, 0-20 yd short game, 20-35 yd short game

blocks.title: Driver corridor (leak 1)
blocks.detail: 36 yd fairway on screen. Full routine every ball. This is the shot that costs you most, so it gets the most balls.

blocks.title: Pitches 5 to 20 yd (leak 2)
blocks.detail: Rotate 5, 12 and 20 yd, three balls at each number, then move on. Land number first, run second.

blocks.title: Pitches 20 to 35 yd (leak 3)
blocks.detail: Rotate 20, 27 and 35 yd, three balls at each number, then move on. Land number first, run second.

blocks.title: Pressure test
blocks.detail: Random distances 60–180, one ball each, full routine. Miss the target and the last three repeat.

note: Export the CSV when you leave and send it to me. Don’t count or judge anything mid-session.

A measurement session, not a practice one: 5 clubs never measured. Full swings at one target, same ball, and read the median rather than your best. 40 balls, scoring clubs first, so the clubs that set your approach yardages are done even if you stop early. What comes out of it is a carry table you can trust on the course. Already measured: 50°, 54°, 58°, 7i, 8i, 9i, Dr, Pw.
